_description: BouonLab 画像生成のトーン固定ファイル（2026-11-09 改定）。generate-image.js が systemContext と preset の suffix を自動で付ける。記事側のプロンプトには『何が写っているか（主題・場面・小道具・構図）』だけを書き、色・画風・文字・人物の指定は書かない。トーンの正本はこのファイル、運用ルールの正本は .workspace/codex/image-style.md。
systemContext: You are creating images for 'BouonLab', a Japanese blog where an ordinary person who researched soundproofing to sleep in a quiet room shares what they found. Character of the images: a calm, organized note handed over by someone who researched carefully — never alarming, never exaggerated, never a construction-site or expert-craftsman look. Visual identity: modern, calm, quiet; Japanese homes, apartments, music rooms, quiet studios, acoustic panels, instruments. Palette: dark warm background close to #17120e with deep brown surfaces close to #241c15, soft warm lighting, and subtle gold accents close to #d4af37; low saturation; no neon. Composition: one clear subject, uncluttered, realistic proportions. Strict rules: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, labels, signs, captions or UI of any language; no human faces (hands or a figure seen from behind are allowed only if the prompt asks); no brand logos or recognizable products; no watermarks or signatures; no fear-inducing or dramatic noise imagery.

cover.label: 記事カバー画像（6:4）
cover.suffix: Aspect ratio: 6:4 (landscape, center-focused composition). Style: editorial blog cover photograph or refined 3D render. The subject must be the specific thing the article is about, recognizable at thumbnail size. No text of any kind.

content.label: 記事内の場面・実物の絵（16:9）。文字なし
content.suffix: Aspect ratio: 16:9 (wide landscape). Style: realistic explanatory illustration of a real situation or physical object, so a reader can picture it in their own home. Show placement, scale and material clearly. No text, numbers, arrows with labels, or diagrams with captions.

portrait.label: 縦長画像（4:6）
portrait.suffix: Aspect ratio: 4:6 (portrait). Style: vertical editorial image for mobile display. Single focal point. No text of any kind.

sns.label: SNS投稿用（1:1）
sns.suffix: Aspect ratio: 1:1 (square). Style: social media image that communicates the topic at a glance while keeping the calm tone. No text of any kind.

infographic.label: （廃止）インフォグラフィック
infographic.disabled: 文字・数値の入る図はAIで生成しない。SVG → PNG（.workspace/codex/image-style.md §5-2）か bouon-memo-image で作る
